correctness: All pages and newest 50 messages equal prior list/sort/slice; synthetic cases and unknown operations preserved
limitations: Small scenario was slightly slower; this is a query measurement, not an application-wide speedup.
OS cache was uncontrolled. SQL scanned rows, lock duration and cold startup were not measured.
No image, real customer data, platform, model inference or whole-machine capacity was measured.
Only before/after process memory snapshots were recorded; they do not establish a peak or absence of leaks.
